text:
Alex K: Quick heads-up — PR is gated on the new infra RFC, need arch sign-off before we can merge to canary. RFC: https://redwood/research/rfcs/2026/interface-routing.md
PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/9123
Context: changes routing fallback to allow regional fallback and adds a config flag `enable_cross_region_fallback=false` by default.

Jamie L: Adding context — this PR alters the routing policy and could affect latency spikes when fallback kicks in. I ran a quick sim with the kv-cache disabled and saw a 12–18% p99 tail increase locally.

Taylor M: @Alex K can you paste the canary plan here? need to see metrics and rollback steps.

Alex K: Canary plan in the PR description (short): 1) 5% traffic in us-west for 2h; 2) monitor p50/p95/p99 + errors; 3) if errors > 0.3% roll back; 4) if p99 regresses > 8% revert. Rollback is automatic via deploy-bot tag if healthcheck fails.

Sophia R: I can do the arch review but need the perf numbers vs current infra. @Jamie L can you drop the sim logs or the minimal run command you used?

Jamie L: sure — command:
```
./scripts/run_lat_sim --disable-kv --requests 100000 --concurrency 50
```
Results: p50: 22ms, p95: 105ms, p99: 255ms (baseline p99 ~225ms). Logs attached in PR.

Sophia R: thanks. quick glance — two things i want clarified: (1) how does this interact with prefix caching? (2) what are the upgrade steps for Dedicated pools? Add answers inline in the PR and ping me.

Alex K: answered (1) — prefix cache unaffected; we still use prefix cache before routing. (2) Dedicated upgrade requires a config toggle in deployment manifest; added manifest diff.

deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed except `integration-tests` — failure in `routing-fallback.test` (timeout). See https://ci/redwood/1234

Taylor M: If integration fails we should not merge. @Sophia R please hold approval until CI green.

Sophia R: Will hold. If Alex can get the integration test flakiness fixed, ping me and I'll re-review. ETA?

Alex K: I'll dig into the flaky test now. Should have a fix by EOD. Thanks all.

Taylor M: Thanks — ping when ready and I'll re-run canary.
